title: If battery dies during bolus delivery you get full bolus anyway but AAPS does record only part of it
symptom: During bolus delivery, if the pump battery dies, AAPS records only a partial bolus (e.g., 1.1 U) even though the pump delivered the full bolus (e.g., 8.7 U). After replacing the battery and syncing, AAPS still shows the partial amount, leading to risk of overdose if unnoticed.
cause: The main R driver does not use history, and any problem with connectivity leads to wrong data almost every time.
fix: Switch to the v2 driver (as the user was not using the v2 driver).
